title: Ryuki external conformance trust reconciliation response
description: Closed response envelope returned by the independently governed conformance trust-checkpoint authority. Schema validity never grants trust: the verifier must use separately provisioned authority, key, fingerprint, minimum-epoch, and transport bindings; verify the domain-separated Ed25519 signature and exact request echo; enforce freshness and trusted-time uncertainty; and require the candidate head, including its locator, to equal the authority's current head. Version 1 is read/reconcile only and cannot bootstrap, relocate, or advance authority state at runtime.

request_digest.description: SHA-256 of the exact unframed ryuki-canonical-json-v1 request bytes, including its unique lexicographically sorted requested_document_digests list of at most 64 complete raw-document SHA-256 digests.

validated_lineage_digest.description: SHA-256 binding of the exact ordered, validated registry lineage supplied with the request. The verifier independently recomputes this value.

outcome.description: Version 1 admits only an exact read/reconcile match. Bootstrap, relocation, rollback, fork resolution, and head advance require a separately authorized administrative protocol and are not representable here.

acceptance_records.description: Bounded, exact accepted-document records observed in the same linearizable namespace history as the trust head. The response must contain exactly one record for every digest in the request's unique lexicographically sorted requested_document_digests list and no others; unsolicited, duplicate, or omitted records fail. Semantic verification requires acceptance_record_id, complete_document_digest, and authority_sequence each to be unique within the response. Empty is valid only for an empty lookup and cannot satisfy a production closure that requires accepted documents.

signature_base64.description: Canonical Base64 encoding of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature. Signing bytes are two consecutive frames: each frame is an unsigned u64 little-endian byte length followed by those bytes; the first frame contains the fixed UTF-8 domain ryuki-v1/conformance-trust-reconciliation-response and the second contains ryuki-canonical-json-v1 bytes of the response object with signature_base64 removed.

nonce.description: Canonical Base64 encoding of exactly 32 unpredictable request bytes.

artifactLocator.description: Normalized safe relative path to the exact registry artifact. Locator changes are authority changes even when content bytes are unchanged.

public_key_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the decoded raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key. The value must equal the independently configured fingerprint; it is never a self-authenticating key declaration.

content_digest.description: SHA-256 of the exact raw registry artifact bytes.

restored_state_reconciled.description: The external authority has reconciled its durable namespace state before returning this proof; a restored or recovering namespace must not claim this value.

no_auto_advance.description: The read/reconcile operation cannot mutate or advance the stored head. Exact preauthorized compare-and-swap is a separate administrative protocol.

sequence.description: Linearizable sequence shared by trust-head and document-acceptance events within the exact namespace.

authority_epoch.description: Fencing epoch that must meet the independently configured minimum authority epoch.

authority_revision.description: Current monotonic external authority record revision for this exact namespace. Every distinct head commit strictly advances this revision.

observed_at.description: Trusted authority observation interval. Semantic verification requires not_after to be no later than the verifier's trusted-now lower bound.

valid_until.description: Exclusive proof-expiry boundary. Semantic verification requires this value to be strictly later than observed_at.not_after, no more than 300 seconds after observed_at.not_before, and strictly later than the verifier's trusted-now upper bound.

trustedTimeInterval.description: Inclusive trusted-time uncertainty interval. A verifier rejects an interval that straddles an acceptance, expiry, revocation, or freshness cutoff.

authority_sequence.description: The acceptance event's position in the same namespace sequence as checkpoint.sequence.

complete_document_digest.description: SHA-256 of the exact complete raw document bytes, including its signature object.

signature_digest.description: SHA-256 of the exact decoded document signature bytes.

signed_subject_digest.description: Digest asserted by the document signature and independently recomputed by the verifier.

head_sequence.description: Namespace sequence at which this exact registry head became current. Semantic verification requires head_sequence <= the acceptance event's authority_sequence <= checkpoint.sequence.

head_authority_revision.description: External authority record revision that committed this exact registry head. Distinct head commits strictly advance the value.
